what_happened: Run 1 (27 observed cells, exit 0, heavy-locked) produced ZERO trades for arms C and C_RELAXED on every cell and NOT_RUN_CONTROL_MATCHING for F/F_RELAXED on every cell.
root_cause: rsmv1/turnover.py::direction_of dispatched direction by V2 strategy NAME only; every A4 specialist name resolved to direction 0 (FLAT). The no-op pass in route_arm therefore collapsed all specialist targets to the standing FLAT string: 0 emitted specialist targets, 0 entries, 0 trades. Arm F's matcher then had an empty invested-label set and correctly failed closed (NOT_RUN_CONTROL_MATCHING) against a degenerate all-FLAT anchor.
evidence_non_pnl: Routing diagnostic (BTC_H1, fold-1 mapping): desired target counts ACC-BASE-RECLAIM-L=9304 bars, UPT-BREAKOUT-L=3493, DNT-CASCADE-S=5828 — but emitted non-FLAT targets=0. The bug is in target emission, independent of any PnL value.

scope.unaffected: Arm C's SELECTION audit and inner evidence were computed correctly in run 1 (the evidence path never passes through direction_of): selections recorded (e.g. BTC_H1 fold1: ACC->ACC-BASE-RECLAIM-L, UP->UPT-BREAKOUT-L, DOWN->DNT-CASCADE-S; fold2 UP->FLAT inner_evidence_unstable; DIST OUTER_FLOOR_THIN) remain valid and are reproduced identically (deterministic) in run 2.

exposure: Run-1 summary and selection audits were READ by A1 after the run. No remediation decision depends on any PnL value: the bug is proven by routing counts alone. The A1/A2/B/D/E numbers are reproductions of TERMINAL V2 outcomes or unaffected control arms; C*/F* outcomes were degenerate (0 trades / fail-closed) and carried no selection information.
repair: direction_of now dispatches specialist names through SPECIALIST_DIRECTIONS (authoritative library table); unknown non-FLAT names fail CLOSED to 0. Regression test test_specialist_directions_dispatch added; suite 121 passed + 1 xfailed; engine equivalence re-MATCH (V2-name dispatch unchanged).
